description: A multi-source clinical-trials intelligence system — aggregates, normalizes, and analyzes trials across ClinicalTrials.gov, EU CTIS, and biomedical sources, with an offline SQLite engine no single-registry tool has.

novel_features.name: Emerging therapy detection
novel_features.description: See the fastest-growing trial categories for a disease area, with percent change.

novel_features.name: Recruitment velocity
novel_features.description: Measure how fast a disease area's trials and enrollment are growing over time.

novel_features.name: Drug compare
novel_features.description: Compare two drugs head-to-head across trial counts, phases, sponsors, and recruiting status.

novel_features.name: Trial risk score
novel_features.description: Get an explainable risk read on a single trial from termination, enrollment, site count, sponsor track record, and phase factor (earlier phases = higher risk).

novel_features.name: Watch with change diff
novel_features.description: Track a term and report new, changed, and terminated trials since the last run.

novel_features.name: Sponsor dominance
novel_features.description: Rank who runs the most trials in an area, classified as industry, academic, or government.

novel_features.name: Multi-source merge
novel_features.description: Search a single normalized trial model aggregated and deduplicated across ClinicalTrials.gov, EU CTIS, and OpenAlex.

novel_features.name: Evidence linkage
novel_features.description: Link a trial to its publications and citation context via PubMed and OpenAlex.

novel_features.name: Safety signals
novel_features.description: Surface FDA adverse-event signals for a trial's intervention drug.

novel_features.name: Clinician landscape report
novel_features.description: Compose search, emerging, hotspots, and sponsors into one markdown or CSV briefing for a topic.

novel_features.name: Per-provider health
novel_features.description: Show live status, latency, and failure rate for every data source in the fallback chain.
